paragraphs: The Vito 115/116 CDI was produced during the W639 generation from 2003 to 2014, using the OM611 and OM646 2.2-litre diesel four-cylinder engines. The OM646 in particular is shared with the Viano of the same platform and is known for timing chain and injector seal wear as a well-documented specialist pattern. The Vito 115/116 CDI is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VITO 115 116 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 2.2-litre I4 diesel fitted to the Vito 115/116 CDI during the W639 generation. Older W638 engines used OM601 and OM611 variants but were offered as 108/109/110/111 CDI, not 115/116 CDI.

A 2.2-litre I4 diesel fitted to the Vito 115/116 CDI across the W639 generation. Known for timing chain wear and injector seal leaks - see the callout above. We replace worn timing chains and injector seals as standard on every OM646 rebuild, along with the gaskets.

compatibility.intro: Because the Vito 115/116 CDI spans two engine codes across the W639 generation, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming parts from one engine will work on the other - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Vito quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
